changes: Sequences: every step can now be edited in place - the pencil button loads the step back into the builder (including Run Chat / Command), so changing 'ah' into '/ah' no longer means deleting and recreating the step
Croesus profit tracker HUD (like /gp): total profit, runs, kismet count and a per-floor breakdown (F7 / M7 / M4 / T1...), movable and scalable in /b gui
Auto Croesus settings are now in the config GUI (Auto Croesus category, bomboclient build): thresholds, delays, kismet, dungeon keys, HUD toggles and the debug highlight switch
The chest value panel is movable/scalable in /b gui, with a sample panel to position it against
AutoCroesus simulation debug no longer repeats the same 'highlighted slot' line every tick - each slot/action is announced once per container (the outline still follows the real decision)
/b cmd history is saved to config/bomboaddons/cmd_history.txt and survives restarts (up arrow recalls it); every Bombo keybind is blocked while the terminal is open, so typing never fires a sequence
/b egg debug|auth|reconnect now exist and always run the handshake - they bypass the Hoppity-season gate, and the websocket connects as soon as the token arrives instead of staying 'Disconnected'

EggAuth no longer crashes with RuntimeException: the profile key pair is read through Minecraft's public getProfileKeyPairManager() instead of a broken accessor mixin, and failures print the real reason (offline account, expired key pair)
New Bombo auth server: POST /mod/auth on bomboapi - aaron-compatible Mojang key-pair verification issuing 6h Bombo tokens; GET /mod/auth/status shows pipeline health
EggFinder auth fallback chain: Skyblocker token -> hysky aaron -> Bombo auth, so /b egg works even when hysky refuses us
Hoppity waypoint writes now require a Bearer token (reads stay open); the mod attaches its token to every publish
Sequences actually run now: the executor ships in both builds (it was cheat-only, so pressing the trigger key did nothing); loop, jitter, repeats and safety halts all work
Click Slot / Item is one field: item name or slot number (5 / slot 5), plus an optional GUI Title guard so the step only fires inside the named GUI
Sequence editor: Ctrl+X cuts, long text scrolls inside its box instead of overflowing, taller action builder
/b cmd: typing while a command runs goes to its stdin (ssh ls works), Ctrl+C interrupts, and the view auto-follows output until you scroll up (End re-arms)
AutoCroesus debug: one summary per GUI visit (no spam) with a hoverable all-chests breakdown; the all-chests value panel now actually renders (its hook was orphaned)

EggFinder: full Skyblocker aaron authentication ported - profile key pair + SHA256withRSA signed data POST to hysky.de with a real token response, auto-refresh 5 min before expiry; fixes status: disconnected
Playtime sync: identifies as the mod (Java default UA was intermittently refused) with explicit timeouts
Chat history: keybind-fired commands keep their Keybind trigger through the deferred execution (pressing B for /bz no longer shows as Server)
Chat history: outgoing rows never show created-by null - keybind-fired commands show Source: BomboAddons with Trigger: Keybind <name>; typed ones show Player Input
Readable key names everywhere: key 258 is now Tab, plus arrows/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End/Insert/Delete/CapsLock in triggers, tooltips and capture buttons
Sequences category fixed on installs with a custom /b order: the organizer file is merged, not applied wholesale, so categories added in newer builds appear; Auto is now displayed as Sequences

/b cmd fixed: a duplicate registration made bare /b cmd run the legacy execute-last-command path; it now opens the terminal, whose session (scrollback, history, running command) survives closing - Ctrl+L clears
Mod ID hiding is always on now (both builds answer the brand query with the vanilla name); the toggle was removed
Updater refuses cross-Minecraft-line updates: a 26.1.x install can no longer update to a 26.2.x jar

Keybind capture supports modifier combos: Ctrl/Alt/Shift open a combo ([CTRL + ...] shown live) and a letter commits Ctrl+A etc.; releasing the modifier alone keeps a single-key bind - fixes Trade Max Pet Hotkey
Performance: Pest ESP only renders in the Garden; Critter Capsule trajectory only runs in the Safari (render and tick) - both rows vanish from /b perf elsewhere
AutoCroesus: new /b ac debug simulation mode (highlights instead of clicking), always-buy and worthless classification sets ported from RandomStuff, pet loot parsing, kismet blacklist respected
EggFinder websocket handshake now byte-matches Skyblocker: Bearer-prefixed aaron token and current Skyblocker/6.10.4 User-Agent (payload envelope already matched)

Account swapper: selection applies the session synchronously from the cached token, so a fast join can no longer connect as the previous account; partial swaps now warn in chat instead of failing silently

Fixed chat history attribution: server messages were labelled 'created by bomboaddons' because our own mixin/routing frames were picked as the caller - infrastructure frames are now skipped and network delivery is detected first

Chat history now merges the [BomboAddons] chat line into the feature event row, so 'Started auto sequence: X' shows Origin, Feature and Trigger (Keybind TAB, Mouse Button 5, Command /b auto run X, Config GUI RUN button) on hover
Chat history opens at the newest message with End/Home/PageUp/PageDown scrolling and no longer resets its scroll on tab change

Chat history tabs are now All, BomboAddons, Mods Only, Normal Chat (includes blocked), Blocked Only and Outgoing, plus an Events chip and a Source column; added /b chathistory bombo|mods|normal|blocked|outgoing|events|clear

Auto sequences are visible and editable in both builds again: the Auto category is no longer gated behind hideCheats and no longer cheat-only (only the executor is), so /b auto and the config card always exist
New auto step type: Right/Left Click NPC with name matcher, search radius and click button, for sequences like right-click NPC -> click slot -> shift-click -> close GUI
Auto sequences gained per-step Repeat counts, a randomised loop cooldown and a per-sequence jitter percentage (default 30) - a 3000ms delay fires between ~2100ms and ~3900ms
Auto sequence commands: /b auto add|remove|run|stop|list|toggle|loop|jitter|key <name> <KEY> - keybind and loop can be edited from chat
BUILD: ./gradlew build now produces BOTH artifacts at once - bomboaddons-<ver>.jar (legit) and bomboclient-<ver>.jar (cheat)
Added assertNoCheatReferences: the build fails if shared code references a cheat package (string literals/comments ignored so the reflective SPI stays legal)
assertFlavorIntegrity now also requires the cheat jar to contain its classes and marker, and stale -sources/-dev jars are deleted from build/libs automatically

Each build now uses its own Fabric mod id (bomboaddons / bomboclient) so a mod-id blacklist on one cannot affect the other; asset namespace is unchanged and a warning is shown if both jars are installed at once
New Hide Mod ID On Join setting (both builds, ON by default): the client answers the server brand query with the vanilla name so the join handshake carries no mod marker
New No Obfuscate setting (/b noobfuscate): strips the section-k scrambling style from chat messages and item lore so the hidden text is readable, keeping colours, formatting and click/hover events
New /b cmd in-game terminal: /b cmd ping 1.1.1.1 opens a real terminal screen and runs the command instantly, with streaming output, scrollback, up/down history, Ctrl+V paste and click-to-copy

Fixed updater reporting 'No releases or update jars found' when a build was simply up to date: the channel version is compared first and the flavor message is only shown for a real update that lacks an artifact for this build
Fixed /b chathistory: ChatHistoryScreen was implemented but never instantiated and no command existed - added /b chathistory, /b chathistory auto|all, a chatHistoryKey keybind and a config GUI button
Fixed a 2px render/click geometry mismatch in ChatHistoryScreen that made the bottom row unclickable, and clamped the scroll offset
Added ChatHistoryTracker.recordEvent with a new EVENT status so feature messages are no longer dropped by the [BomboAddons] filter
Auto sequence starts, stops, completions and halts are now recorded in chat history with their real trigger (Keybind TAB, Mouse Button 5, Config GUI RUN button, Command /b auto run)
Chat history tooltips now show Origin, Feature, Trigger and Sequence lines, plus a new Auto Sequences filter tab
Added /b auto list, /b auto run <name> and /b auto stop commands
Auto sequences now retry a failed step 3x before halting, with the reason recorded (container closed, slot not found, player left the world, sequence deleted, no steps)
Dual flavor build: ./gradlew build produces the legit bomboaddons jar and ./gradlew build -Pflavor=cheat produces bomboclient
Cheat-only sources moved to src/cheat/java behind a reflective FlavorBridge SPI so the legit jar never links a cheat type, enforced by a new assertFlavorIntegrity build task
Moved to cheat-only: the sequence executor, /b hide, the Auto category registration and a cheat-only ClientBrandRetriever mixin
Flavor-aware updater: /b update only installs the artifact matching the running flavor and old-jar cleanup is scoped per flavor; added /b update flavor and /b update switch
Added FlavorMigration that detects legacy cheat state (hideCheats=false or automation configured) and migrates it safely; config schema version bumped to 2
Added stealth mode (/b stealth) stopping bridge presence posts, egg publishing and modded brand advertisement, documented as identity hygiene rather than undetectability
Fixed .gitignore: a bare config/ pattern kept 5 build-critical gui/config sources out of version control - anchored to /config/ and tracked them
Added docs/FEATURE_AUDIT.md with the feature reachability audit, measured coverage numbers and the no-deletion policy
Added mod update channel setting ('Full Only' vs 'Betas & Full') in BomboConfig
Integrated channel filtering into /b update and background update checks
Enhanced /b update with subcommands: /b update full, /b update beta, and /b update channel <full|beta>
Added Update Channel cycle selector and Check For Updates button in Config GUI (General category)
Automated update downloads from api.bombo.dpdns.org/mod/version directly with proper jar naming and pending cleanup
Guarded custom SkyBlock item creation with SkyblockItemManager check in TotemAnimationManager to prevent vanilla items (such as lead) from showing missing stone textures
Fixed Ctrl+A in InventorySlotColorScreen to select all text with highlight rather than erasing it, plus added full Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo/redo history
Enhanced InventoryButtonsScreen text inputs with word deletion (Ctrl+Delete, Ctrl+Backspace), cursor navigation, clipboard shortcuts, and localized undo/redo
Aspect of the Void Base Texture Override in ItemModelResolverMixin to bypass broken warped variant texture overrides
Compact Chat History screen layout (13px rows) matching SkyHanni /shchathistory
Accurate mod origin detection in ChatHistoryTracker skipping Mixin generated and Minecraft proxy methods (Devonian, BomboAddons, SkyHanni, BetterPV, NEU, Odin, Skytils)
Captured blocked/suppressed messages via Fabric ClientReceiveMessageEvents GAME_CANCELED and CHAT_CANCELED in ChatHistoryTracker
Added interactive [Press Key...] keybind capture button for Clicker Trigger Keybind in ConfigCustomWidgets
New 'Auto' Automation Category and Sequence Manager (slot/item clicking, close GUI, run command, click in world/NPC, wait pauses, loop toggles, and hotkey listeners)
Minecraft 26.2 Fabric loader and mapping updates
Container slot color customizer enhancements
Inventory quick macro buttons system
Hypixel SkyBlock dynamic texturepack synchronization
Advanced chat history search and filtering
Restrict storage preview hover to storage containers only
Unified versioning system across build files
Etherwarp lore range check
Highlight search bar and category refinements
Diana lootshare recursion safety fix
